messages.subject: Reliability problem
parts:

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Reliability problem
parts:
Chuck,

Stefano and Alberto have the right idea. There is a function alpha in
both the ggplot2 and psych packages. It looks like you are loading
psych first, and then loading ggplot2, which causes ggplot2 to mask
alpha. Go to the package manager and uncheck default for the psych
package (or any package depending on psych except
DeducerPlugInScaling). Restart JGR and see if it works now.

Alberto, I have changed the development version of
DeducerPlugInScaling to use psych::alpha to remove the possibility of
this error. Give it a try, and if there are no problems we can push to
CRAN.


Best,
Ian
